item.title: Some People Really Hate Gender-Neutral Restrooms
item.description: Read Some People Really Hate Gender-Neutral Restrooms Our store is having a remodel. As a result, they close the men's restroom and remove the sign on the ladies' restroom to make it co-ed. The remodelling crew boards up the men's room with plywood and then heads home for the night. The store is open until ten, so we still have customers coming in and out. Read Some People Really Hate Gender-Neutral Restrooms
